comparison.objective: Meter a hydraulic release valve to lower a fragile cabinet gently; candidate tunes a hydraulic damper for safe repeatable stops.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuously regulate a load-dependent valve during descent versus iteratively adjust and lock a passive setting between guarded impact trials.
comparison.success_condition: Cabinet lands at safe speed without glass contact and remains supported hands-off versus two cycles without bottoming, hard-stop strike, overload, rebound or drift.
comparison.reason: Despite different hardware and control timing, both centrally test using hydraulic adjustment informed by physical motion to achieve a safe, bounded deceleration and stable final support/stop.
